id: title:GeneralistDev:let users copy posthog home into a dashboard

review.posthog_relevance: Adds a read-only display mode and a recovery handler for missing dashboards, potentially supporting shared or read-only dashboard views and team restoration.
review.reason: The chunk P1.F4.H1 adds a readOnly prop and its propagation, while P1.F12.H1 adds a recovery handler. This represents a substantive, bounded capability improvement rather than narrow maintenance, but the tier is capped at 2 because the chunk lacks the implementation of the HomeTabDashboard and shared template storage, preventing a complete assessment of the broader systemic benefit
review.uncertainty: The chunk does not include the implementation of the HomeTabDashboard, homeTabDashboardProps, or homeTabDashboardLogic, nor the dashboardNotFound action or the onCopyPostHogHome handler implementation. The tests and the HomeTab switch are present, but the supporting backend and shared dashboard-creation logic are absent. This prevents a complete assessment of tier and tier. No

observations.behavior: Adds a new kea logic, homeTabDashboardLogic, that wraps dashboardLogic and teamLogic, and exposes dashboard and error404 values, plus a dashboardNotFound listener that reloads the team.
observations.posthog_connection: This could support a Home tab dashboard that, when its dashboard is missing, reloads the team to restore the Home dashboard. This is a localised implementation, not a systemic capability.
